Below is a one‐line patch to make the `--no-emulated-user-agent` flag actually work. By changing the flag’s yargs `type` from `"string"` to `"boolean"`, yargs will automatically generate the `--no-…` negated form and correctly set `settings.emulatedUserAgent = false` when you pass `--no-emulated-user-agent`.

```javascript
### cli/cli-flags.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
      'emulatedUserAgent': {
        type: 'string',
        coerce: coerceOptionalStringBoolean,
        describe: 'Sets useragent emulation',
      },
=======
      'emulatedUserAgent': {
        type: 'boolean',
        coerce: coerceOptionalStringBoolean,
        describe: 'Sets useragent emulation',
      },
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

With that in place, running:

  lighthouse … --no-emulated-user-agent …

will correctly disable UA emulation and prevent the “Emulated Moto G4…” footer from appearing.
